row.evidence: Shopify's help centre says 'SCIM user management is available only for organizations on the Shopify Plus plan', and the pricing page lists Plus from $2,300/mo.
row.notes: Status unchanged from June (gated, Plus). Team plan changed from Basic to Grow: Shopify's help centre says users are available only on Grow and higher (Basic and Starter allow 0 staff accounts), so Basic is effectively single-user. Pricing is per store, not per user, so per-user fields and the multiplier are null (June stored $29 and $2,300 as per-user values and a 79.3x multiplier). Grow is $79/mo yearly or $105/mo monthly; Plus is listed only as 'from $2,300/mo' (the page shows no separate yearly Plus price). SAML is also Plus-only and must be set up, with a verified domain, before generating the SCIM token. SCIM removal suspends the user; group assignment uses a roles attribute that must match an existing Shopify group; Okta Group Push is not supported. Docs are cited as the help centre's .md exports because the HTML pages block automated requests.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Up to 15 staff accounts; read-only StaffMember API.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Unlimited staff accounts; custom user groups.

auth.token_source: Shopify admin > Settings > Users > Security > SCIM integration > Generate API token

endpoints.notes: Only the base URL and user request bodies are documented; no endpoint reference.

operations.notes: Group push is not supported for Okta; group membership is set through the roles attribute on the user. Permanent deletion in the IdP "might" delete the user depending on IdP setup.

roles.how: roles attribute (labelled Role Name in the Okta/OneLogin apps, an app role in Entra) carries a Shopify group name; only the last value is used; the group must already exist in Shopify

limitations.text: Requires a verified domain and a SAML configuration; only users on a verified domain can be managed.
Store and organization owners can't be removed through the IdP.
Okta Group Push is not supported.
SCIM-created users get no invitation email and stay Pending until they sign in through the IdP.
Deleting the SCIM token cannot be undone; reconnecting needs a new token.

endpoints.purpose: List staff members with filtering and cursor pagination
Get a staff member by ID, or the requesting staff member

rate_limits.text: Most Admin API rate limits use a leaky-bucket algorithm; Plus advertises up to 500% higher API call limits.

limitations.text: StaffMember access needs the read_users scope, which Shopify Support must enable, and the app must be a finance embedded app or installed on a Plus or Advanced store. No staff-member mutations were found (staffMemberCreate/staffMemberUpdate pages 404).

okta.notes: App is "Shopify Plus". OIN page markup marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate as checked; Group Push is not.

onelogin.notes: From Shopify's help centre; OneLogin's connector page not loaded.

open_questions: No SCIM endpoint reference: Groups, discovery endpoints, filtering and pagination are undocumented.
Whether IdP deletion deletes the user is described only as "might be deleted ... depending on your identity provider setup".
Whether SCIM suspension frees a staff seat or ends sessions is not documented.
SCIM token expiry not documented (Entra calls it a long-lived bearer token).
No public audit-log API or staff webhooks found; the user management activity log is admin-UI only.
Google Workspace and JumpCloud catalogue status not verified.
